name: Sonar
summary:
Sonar provides code quality and application security solutions that help organisations improve software reliability, maintainability, and secure development practices.

Together, we help organisations design, integrate, and operate Sonar technologies across modern software delivery and platform engineering environments. From code quality governance and security analysis through to CI/CD integration and developer enablement, we help teams create secure, reliable, and operationally consistent software delivery platforms.
overview:
Sonar technologies help organisations improve software quality and application security across modern development environments.

Together, we help organisations build, integrate, and operate Sonar environments across cloud-native, enterprise, and platform engineering ecosystems. From automated code analysis and security scanning through to CI/CD integration and operational governance, we help teams create environments that support reliable, scalable, and secure software delivery practices.

Our focus is on building strong software delivery foundations that support long-term engineering quality and operational consistency. This includes code quality management, security analysis, automation, observability, lifecycle management, and developer enablement across complex engineering environments.

We help organisations reduce technical debt, improve delivery confidence, and maintain secure and reliable software development operations.
